text: In humility we ask you, almighty God: command that these offerings be carried by the hands of your holy Angel to your altar on high, in the presence of your divine majesty, so that all of us who, by sharing in this altar, have received the most holy Body and Blood of your Son may be filled with every heavenly blessing and grace.
